decisions.reason: After two years the organic poultry snack still fits the organic push, and with industry growth and slack the firm can keep it, though dropping the organic flagship platter shows management will prune organic items that miss aspirations.
The premium sharing snack line builds on core salami expertise and has no signal of falling below aspiration, so management has no trigger for problemistic search and keeps it.
Organic Fleischwurst is a newly launched, low-risk extension of a staple category and has had too little time to be judged against aspirations, so slack lets the firm carry it.
The organic thin-sliced chicken breast line was just launched in two flavours, supports the organic and new-format strategy, and is still too early to evaluate.

The herb-coated organic salami is close to the core offer and recent, so without evidence of a performance shortfall it is kept, with some risk given the earlier withdrawal of the organic salami platter.
